objective: zero-shot K562 untreated/DMSO measured growth gamma source transfer
independence: four cohorts from two later studies with two independently transduced infections each; shared lab lineage, not independent laboratories
model: unchanged validation-selected K562 independent completion; original singles and coefficients; no external fitting or normalization regression
primary_population: distinct supported-gene pairs absent from entire original eligible bank; minimum 50 pairs and 10 genes per cohort
other_strata: original test previously scored; original validation selection-exposed; original train repeatability only
coverage: whole-library filtering before gene selection; mean across infections of each guide's within-position median T0 count must exceed 35 in BOTH positions; both construct T0 counts must exceed 50; common construct panel across infections; at least two distinct ordered guide constructs per canonical pair
normalization: add 10 to counts, log2 reference endpoint/T0, subtract surviving negative-negative median per infection, divide author reference cumulative doublings; sequencing fraction normalization cancels after control centering
environment_deviation: T0-only coverage replaces author's endpoint-count guide filter, declared before scoring to avoid selecting on depletion; not exact published-score reproduction
aggregation: equal ordered guide construct weights within infection, then equal infection weights; orientations and technical reads are not biological replicates
secondary: external measured single sum and minimum, extra-information assay-shift diagnostic only, no fitted calibration
metrics: MSE primary on mean of two infection gamma targets; MAE/bias/Pearson and each infection separately; replicate disagreement descriptive only
uncertainty: 2000 pair-resampling and gene-resampling draws seed 20261020; resample unique genes with replacement and edge weight multiplicity(a)*multiplicity(b); discard zero-total draws and record actual count; conditional on measured cultures, not biological-population intervals
success: all four cohorts qualify; in every cohort completion mean-target MSE at least 2% below frozen main effects, lower MSE in each infection, gene-resampling upper 95% loss-difference bound below zero, and no mean-target loss to other frozen simple baselines
failure: no rescue tuning, no retraining, no primary-panel expansion; evaluate assay-shift diagnostics and identify a falsifiable next hypothesis only
distribution: raw counts, derived numeric banks and model assets local only; source rights remain separate
missing_counts: Blank required T0/reference counts are unavailable, never zero-imputed; exclude incomplete constructs before normalization; record exclusions and possible dropout bias.
